title: CHG-7137: change to the Order Pipeline
body:
Summary

The Order Pipeline change described below is declined as of this writing. Mateo Silva (Service Desk)
raised it, and 27 production hosts behind the Order Pipeline are in scope for the work.

Details

The implementation plan, prepared with Bluegate Networks, covers these steps during the 02:00-04:00
UTC window:
- Replace the hand-maintained cron schedule with the workflow engine
- Split the shared config file into one file per environment
- Archive records older than seven years to cold storage

Decision

As recorded by the board, this change is declined. Minutes taken by Grace Okafor, 16 October 2025,
covering the session held on 19 August 2025, are kept in the shared archive.
